views.oneRowIs: one academic year of the school

examples.question: Which is the current academic year and when does it end?
examples.sql: SELECT academic_year, name, start_date, end_date FROM nlq.academic_years WHERE is_current

examples.question: List all academic years with their status
examples.sql: SELECT academic_year, name, status, start_date, end_date FROM nlq.academic_years ORDER BY start_date DESC

examples.question: How many days are left in this session?
examples.sql: SELECT academic_year, end_date, end_date - (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS days_left FROM nlq.academic_years WHERE is_current

views.oneRowIs: one pupil in one academic year (class, section, roll number)

examples.question: How many pupils are there in each class now?
examples.sql: SELECT class, count(*) AS pupils FROM nlq.students WHERE is_current GROUP BY class, class_order ORDER BY class_order

examples.question: Boys and girls in each section
examples.sql: SELECT class_section, count(*) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'male') AS boys, count(*) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'female') AS girls, count(*) AS total FROM nlq.students WHERE is_current GROUP BY class_section, class_order, section ORDER BY class_order, section

examples.question: Category-wise strength of class X
examples.sql: SELECT COALESCE(category, 'Not recorded') AS category, count(*) AS pupils FROM nlq.students WHERE is_current AND class = 'X' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY pupils DESC

examples.question: How many pupils left the school this year, and how?
examples.sql: SELECT s.enrolment_status, count(*) AS pupils FROM nlq.students s JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = s.academic_year_id WHERE y.is_current AND s.enrolment_status IN ('withdrawn', 'transferred', 'left') GROUP BY s.enrolment_status ORDER BY pupils DESC

examples.question: House-wise strength of the school
examples.sql: SELECT COALESCE(house, 'No house') AS house, count(*) AS pupils FROM nlq.students WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY pupils DESC

views.oneRowIs: one class-section of one academic year

examples.question: Who is the class teacher of each section, and how many pupils are there?
examples.sql: SELECT class_section, class_teacher, strength FROM nlq.class_sections WHERE is_current_year ORDER BY class_order, section

examples.question: Which sections have vacant seats?
examples.sql: SELECT class_section, capacity, strength, capacity - strength AS vacant FROM nlq.class_sections WHERE is_current_year AND capacity > strength ORDER BY vacant DESC

examples.question: Sections without a class teacher
examples.sql: SELECT class_section, strength FROM nlq.class_sections WHERE is_current_year AND class_teacher IS NULL ORDER BY class_order, section

examples.question: Class strength this year against last year
examples.sql: SELECT cs.class, cs.class_order, sum(cs.strength) FILTER (WHERE y.is_current) AS this_year, sum(cs.strength) FILTER (WHERE NOT y.is_current) AS last_year FROM nlq.class_sections cs JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = cs.academic_year_id WHERE y.start_date BETWEEN (SELECT c.start_date - interval '1 year' FROM nlq.academic_years c WHERE c.is_current) AND (SELECT c.start_date FROM nlq.academic_years c WHERE c.is_current) GROUP BY cs.class, cs.class_order ORDER BY cs.class_order

views.oneRowIs: one employee of the school (current or former)

examples.question: How many staff do we have in each department?
examples.sql: SELECT department, count(*) AS staff FROM nlq.staff WHERE is_current GROUP BY department ORDER BY staff DESC

examples.question: Teaching and non-teaching staff by gender
examples.sql: SELECT staff_group, gender, count(*) AS staff FROM nlq.staff WHERE is_current GROUP BY staff_group, gender ORDER BY staff_group, gender

examples.question: Who joined this financial year?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_code, employee_name, department, designation, joined_on FROM nlq.staff WHERE joined_on BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2027-03-31' ORDER BY joined_on

examples.question: How many staff left each month this year?
examples.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', left_on)::date AS month, count(*) AS leavers FROM nlq.staff WHERE left_on BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2027-03-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

examples.question: Which staff have no EduPro login?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_code, employee_name, department FROM nlq.staff WHERE is_current AND NOT has_login ORDER BY department, employee_name

views.oneRowIs: one child's admission application (registration) in one session

examples.question: Class-wise registrations, in process, admitted and closed for the 2027-28 admissions
examples.sql: SELECT class, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_registered) AS registered, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_in_process) AS in_process, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_selected) AS selected_or_waiting, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_admitted) AS admitted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_closed) AS closed FROM nlq.admission_applications WHERE admission_session = '2027-28' GROUP BY class, class_order ORDER BY class_order

examples.question: Registration and admission fee collected by class for the 2027-28 admissions
examples.sql: SELECT class, sum(registration_fee_paid) AS registration_fees, sum(admission_fee_paid) AS admission_fees, sum(refunded) AS refunded, sum(registration_fee_paid + admission_fee_paid - refunded) AS net FROM nlq.admission_applications WHERE admission_session = '2027-28' GROUP BY class, class_order ORDER BY class_order

examples.question: Offers not yet paid that expire this week
examples.sql: SELECT registration_no, class, admission_fee, admission_fee_paid, offer_expires_on FROM nlq.admission_applications WHERE status = 'offered' AND offer_expires_on BETWEEN (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AND (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date + 7 ORDER BY offer_expires_on

examples.question: Registrations completed each day this month
examples.sql: SELECT registered_on, count(*) AS registrations, count(*) FILTER (WHERE entered_at_desk) AS at_desk FROM nlq.admission_applications WHERE registered_on >= date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)::date GROUP BY registered_on ORDER BY registered_on

examples.question: Where are registrations waiting for a decision, and for how long?
examples.sql: SELECT class, stage, level_no, count(*) AS waiting, max((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - waiting_since_on) AS longest_wait_days FROM nlq.admission_applications WHERE stage IS NOT NULL GROUP BY class, class_order, stage, level_no ORDER BY class_order, stage, level_no

views.oneRowIs: one admission enquiry (lead)

examples.question: Enquiries by source for the 2027-28 admissions, with registrations and admissions
examples.sql: SELECT source, count(*) AS enquiries, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_registered) AS registered, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_admitted) AS admitted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_lost) AS lost FROM nlq.admission_enquiries WHERE admission_session = '2027-28' GROUP BY source ORDER BY enquiries DESC

examples.question: Open enquiries and overdue follow-ups for each counsellor
examples.sql: SELECT COALESCE(counsellor, 'Unassigned') AS counsellor, count(*) AS open_enquiries, count(*) FILTER (WHERE follow_up_overdue) AS overdue, count(*) FILTER (WHERE score = 'hot') AS hot FROM nlq.admission_enquiries WHERE is_open GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY open_enquiries DESC

examples.question: Enquiries received each month
examples.sql: SELECT month, count(*) AS enquiries, count(*) FILTER (WHERE from_website) AS from_website FROM nlq.admission_enquiries WHERE enquired_on > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 365 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

examples.question: How quickly do counsellors make the first contact?
examples.sql: SELECT COALESCE(counsellor, 'Unassigned') AS counsellor, count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_contact_on IS NOT NULL) AS contacted, round(avg(hours_to_first_contact), 1) AS avg_hours_to_first_contact, count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_contact_late) AS late_now FROM nlq.admission_enquiries GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_hours_to_first_contact NULLS LAST

views.oneRowIs: one unit of an asset item in the asset register (one tag)

examples.question: How many assets do we hold in each category and what are they worth?
examples.sql: SELECT category, count(*) AS assets, sum(cost) AS cost, sum(book_value) AS book_value FROM nlq.assets WHERE is_on_books GROUP BY category ORDER BY book_value DESC

examples.question: Which assets does each department hold?
examples.sql: SELECT department, item, count(*) AS assets FROM nlq.assets WHERE is_on_books AND department IS NOT NULL GROUP BY department, item ORDER BY department, item

examples.question: Which assets are under repair or lost, and who had them?
examples.sql: SELECT asset_code, item, status, department, employee_name FROM nlq.assets WHERE status IN ('under_repair', 'lost') ORDER BY status, asset_code

examples.question: Which assets go out of warranty in the next 60 days?
examples.sql: SELECT asset_code, item, department, warranty_until FROM nlq.assets WHERE is_on_books AND warranty_until BETWEEN current_date AND current_date + 60 ORDER BY warranty_until

examples.question: Which assets are still with staff who have left?
examples.sql: SELECT a.employee_name, a.employee_code, s.left_on, a.asset_code, a.item, a.book_value FROM nlq.assets a JOIN nlq.staff s ON s.employee_id = a.employee_id WHERE a.is_on_books AND NOT s.is_current ORDER BY a.employee_name, a.asset_code

views.oneRowIs: one pupil's mark in the day register of one school day

examples.question: Who was absent today?
examples.sql: SELECT class_section, admission_no, student_name FROM nlq.attendance_days WHERE on_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AND is_absent ORDER BY class_order, section, student_name

examples.question: Attendance % of each class this month
examples.sql: SELECT class, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_present) / count(*), 1) AS attendance_pct, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_absent) AS absences FROM nlq.attendance_days WHERE on_date >= date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)::date AND on_date <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date GROUP BY class, class_order ORDER BY class_order

examples.question: Pupils with attendance below 75% this year
examples.sql: SELECT a.class_section, a.admission_no, a.student_name, count(*) AS days, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.is_present) AS present, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.is_present) / count(*), 1) AS attendance_pct FROM nlq.attendance_days a JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = a.academic_year_id WHERE y.is_current GROUP BY a.class_section, a.class_order, a.section, a.admission_no, a.student_name HAVING count(*) >= 20 AND 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.is_present) / count(*) < 75 ORDER BY attendance_pct

examples.question: Girls' and boys' attendance this month
examples.sql: SELECT s.gender, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.is_present) / count(*), 1) AS attendance_pct FROM nlq.attendance_days a JOIN nlq.students s ON s.student_id = a.student_id AND s.academic_year_id = a.academic_year_id WHERE a.on_date >= date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)::date GROUP BY s.gender ORDER BY s.gender

examples.question: Late arrivals by class this week
examples.sql: SELECT class, count(*) AS late_marks FROM nlq.attendance_days WHERE is_late AND on_date > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 7 GROUP BY class, class_order ORDER BY class_order

views.oneRowIs: one certificate paper in the register (an original or a duplicate), for a student or a staff member

examples.question: How many certificates of each type were issued this academic year?
examples.sql: SELECT type, count(*) FILTER (WHERE copy_no = 0) AS issued, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_duplicate) AS duplicates, count(*) FILTER (WHERE copy_no = 0 AND status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled FROM nlq.certificates WHERE academic_year = '2026-27' GROUP BY type ORDER BY issued DESC

examples.question: How many TCs were issued in each class this academic year?
examples.sql: SELECT c.class, c.class_order, count(*) AS tcs FROM nlq.certificates c JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = c.academic_year_id WHERE y.is_current AND c.type_code = 'TC' AND c.is_valid GROUP BY c.class, c.class_order ORDER BY c.class_order

examples.question: How many certificates did we issue each month since April?
examples.sql: SELECT month, count(*) AS issued FROM nlq.certificates WHERE copy_no = 0 AND issued_on >= DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

examples.question: Which certificates were issued although a check failed?
examples.sql: SELECT number, type, person_name, issued_on, issued_by FROM nlq.certificates WHERE is_override ORDER BY issued_on DESC

examples.question: Who in the office issued the most certificates this month?
examples.sql: SELECT issued_by, count(*) AS issued FROM nlq.certificates WHERE copy_no = 0 AND month = date_trunc('month', current_date)::date GROUP BY issued_by ORDER BY issued DESC

views.oneRowIs: one pupil's paper (subject) in one exam — pupil × exam × subject

examples.question: Subject-wise average, highest, absentees and failures of Class IX in Term 1 (verified marks)
examples.sql: SELECT m.subject_name, count(*) AS pupils, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.is_entered) AS entered, round(avg(m.percent), 1) AS average_percent, max(m.marks) AS highest, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.code = 'AB') AS absent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.is_failed) AS failed FROM nlq.exam_marks m JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = m.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE m.exam_code = 'T1' AND m.class = 'Class IX' AND m.is_verified GROUP BY m.subject_order, m.subject_name ORDER BY m.subject_order

examples.question: Which Term 1 marks sheets are not verified yet, and how many marks are still missing?
examples.sql: SELECT m.class_section, m.subject_name, m.entry_status, count(*) AS pupils, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT m.is_entered) AS marks_missing FROM nlq.exam_marks m JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = m.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE m.exam_code = 'T1' AND NOT m.is_verified AND m.enrolment_status = 'active' GROUP BY m.class_order, m.class_section, m.subject_order, m.subject_name, m.entry_status ORDER BY m.class_order, m.class_section, m.subject_order

examples.question: Who was absent in any paper of PT1?
examples.sql: SELECT m.class_section, m.admission_no, m.student_name, string_agg(m.subject_name, ', ' ORDER BY m.subject_order) AS absent_in FROM nlq.exam_marks m JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = m.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE m.exam_code = 'PT1' AND m.code = 'AB' GROUP BY m.class_order, m.class_section, m.admission_no, m.student_name ORDER BY m.class_order, m.class_section, m.student_name

examples.question: Which pupils failed Mathematics in Term 1?
examples.sql: SELECT m.class_section, m.admission_no, m.student_name, m.marks, m.max_marks, m.pass_marks, m.code FROM nlq.exam_marks m JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = m.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE m.exam_code = 'T1' AND m.subject_name = 'Mathematics' AND m.is_failed ORDER BY m.class_order, m.class_section, m.marks NULLS FIRST

examples.question: Average English marks in Term 1 by class, boys and girls
examples.sql: SELECT m.class, s.gender, round(avg(m.percent), 1) AS average_percent, count(*) AS pupils FROM nlq.exam_marks m JOIN nlq.students s ON s.student_id = m.student_id AND s.academic_year_id = m.academic_year_id JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = m.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE m.exam_code = 'T1' AND m.subject_name = 'English' AND m.is_verified AND m.marks IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.class_order, m.class, s.gender ORDER BY m.class_order, s.gender

views.oneRowIs: one pupil's overall result in one exam (as last computed)

examples.question: Class-wise pass percentage and average percent in Term 1
examples.sql: SELECT r.class, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.result IN ('pass', 'fail')) AS pupils_with_result, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.result = 'pass') AS passed, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.result = 'pass') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.result IN ('pass', 'fail')), 0), 1) AS pass_percent, round(avg(r.percent) FILTER (WHERE r.result IN ('pass', 'fail')), 1) AS average_percent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.result = 'incomplete') AS incomplete FROM nlq.exam_results r JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = r.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE r.exam_code = 'T1' GROUP BY r.class_order, r.class ORDER BY r.class_order

examples.question: Top three in each section of Class X in Term 1
examples.sql: SELECT r.class_section, r.rank_in_section, r.admission_no, r.student_name, r.total, r.max_total, r.percent, r.grade FROM nlq.exam_results r JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = r.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE r.exam_code = 'T1' AND r.class = 'Class X' AND r.rank_in_section <= 3 ORDER BY r.class_section, r.rank_in_section, r.student_name

examples.question: Pupils who failed two or more papers in Term 1
examples.sql: SELECT r.class_section, r.admission_no, r.student_name, r.failed_subjects, r.percent FROM nlq.exam_results r JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = r.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE r.exam_code = 'T1' AND r.failed_subjects >= 2 ORDER BY r.class_order, r.class_section, r.failed_subjects DESC, r.student_name

examples.question: Grade-wise number of pupils in Class VI for PT1
examples.sql: SELECT r.class_section, COALESCE(r.grade, 'No grade') AS grade, count(*) AS pupils FROM nlq.exam_results r JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = r.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE r.exam_code = 'PT1' AND r.class = 'Class VI' AND r.result <> 'incomplete' GROUP BY r.class_section, r.grade ORDER BY r.class_section, r.grade

examples.question: Average Term 1 percent of boys and girls in each section
examples.sql: SELECT r.class_section, s.gender, count(*) AS pupils, round(avg(r.percent), 1) AS average_percent FROM nlq.exam_results r JOIN nlq.students s ON s.student_id = r.student_id AND s.academic_year_id = r.academic_year_id JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = r.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE r.exam_code = 'T1' AND r.result IN ('pass', 'fail') GROUP BY r.class_order, r.class_section, s.gender ORDER BY r.class_order, r.class_section, s.gender

views.oneRowIs: one bill line of a pupil: one fee head for one fee month of one academic year (school or hostel ledger)

examples.question: Which classes have the most overdue fee this year?
examples.sql:
SELECT class, sum(balance) AS overdue
  FROM nlq.fee_bills
 WHERE academic_year_id = (SELECT academic_year_id FROM nlq.academic_years WHERE is_current)
   AND due_on < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
 GROUP BY class, class_order
HAVING sum(balance) > 0
 ORDER BY class_order

examples.question: Top 20 pupils with the highest overdue fee
examples.sql:
SELECT admission_no, student_name, class_section,
       sum(balance) AS overdue,
       min(due_on) FILTER (WHERE balance > 0) AS oldest_unpaid_due
  FROM nlq.fee_bills
 WHERE academic_year_id = (SELECT academic_year_id FROM nlq.academic_years WHERE is_current)
   AND due_on < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
 GROUP BY student_id, admission_no, student_name, class_section
HAVING sum(balance) > 0
 ORDER BY overdue DESC
 LIMIT 20

examples.question: School fee billed and collected month by month this year
examples.sql:
SELECT fee_month,
       sum(net) AS billed,
       sum(paid) AS collected,
       sum(balance) AS balance,
       round(100 * sum(paid) / NULLIF(sum(net), 0), 1) AS collected_pct
  FROM nlq.fee_bills
 WHERE academic_year_id = (SELECT academic_year_id FROM nlq.academic_years WHERE is_current)
   AND ledger = 'school'
 GROUP BY fee_month
 ORDER BY fee_month

examples.question: Ageing of unpaid hostel fee
examples.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN days_overdue = 0 THEN 'Not yet due'
            WHEN days_overdue <= 30 THEN '1-30 days'
            WHEN days_overdue <= 60 THEN '31-60 days'
            WHEN days_overdue <= 90 THEN '61-90 days'
            ELSE 'Over 90 days' END AS ageing,
       count(DISTINCT student_id) AS pupils,
       sum(balance) AS balance
  FROM nlq.fee_bills
 WHERE academic_year_id = (SELECT academic_year_id FROM nlq.academic_years WHERE is_current)
   AND ledger = 'hostel'
   AND balance > 0
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY min(days_overdue)

examples.question: Which pupils of VI-A have paid nothing so far this year?
examples.sql:
SELECT admission_no, student_name, sum(net) AS billed_so_far
  FROM nlq.fee_bills
 WHERE academic_year_id = (SELECT academic_year_id FROM nlq.academic_years WHERE is_current)
   AND class_section = 'VI-A'
   AND due_on < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
 GROUP BY student_id, admission_no, student_name
HAVING sum(paid) = 0 AND sum(net) > 0
 ORDER BY student_name

views.oneRowIs: one bill line with something taken off it, split into waivers and other concession, with the pupil's concession types

examples.question: How much concession did each concession type give this year?
examples.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(discount_types, 'No concession type (waiver, write-off or refund)') AS concession_type,
       count(DISTINCT student_id) AS pupils,
       sum(concession) AS concession
  FROM nlq.fee_concessions
 WHERE academic_year_id = (SELECT academic_year_id FROM nlq.academic_years WHERE is_current)
   AND concession > 0
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY concession DESC

examples.question: Fee waivers approved this year, by class
examples.sql:
SELECT class, count(DISTINCT student_id) AS pupils_waived, sum(waived) AS waived
  FROM nlq.fee_concessions
 WHERE academic_year_id = (SELECT academic_year_id FROM nlq.academic_years WHERE is_current)
   AND waived > 0
 GROUP BY class, class_order
 ORDER BY class_order

examples.question: Concession on each fee head as a share of the fee
examples.sql:
SELECT head, sum(gross) AS gross, sum(concession) AS concession,
       round(100 * sum(concession) / NULLIF(sum(gross), 0), 1) AS concession_pct
  FROM nlq.fee_concessions
 WHERE academic_year_id = (SELECT academic_year_id FROM nlq.academic_years WHERE is_current)
 GROUP BY head
 ORDER BY concession DESC

examples.question: Pupils with the highest concession this year
examples.sql:
SELECT admission_no, student_name, class_section, discount_types, sum(concession) AS concession
  FROM nlq.fee_concessions
 WHERE academic_year_id = (SELECT academic_year_id FROM nlq.academic_years WHERE is_current)
 GROUP BY student_id, admission_no, student_name, class_section, discount_types
 ORDER BY concession DESC
 LIMIT 20

views.oneRowIs: the part of one fee receipt set against one fee head for one fee month (plus late fee and advance rows)

examples.question: Head-wise fee collection this month
examples.sql:
SELECT ledger, head, sum(amount) AS collected
  FROM nlq.fee_receipt_heads
 WHERE month = date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)::date
 GROUP BY ledger, head
 ORDER BY ledger, collected DESC

examples.question: Transport fee collected by class this financial year
examples.sql:
SELECT class, sum(amount) AS transport_collected
  FROM nlq.fee_receipt_heads
 WHERE head_kind = 'transport'
   AND received_on BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2027-03-31'
 GROUP BY class, class_order
 ORDER BY class_order

examples.question: How much of this month's collection was for earlier months, this month or ahead?
examples.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN line_kind <> 'fee' THEN line_kind
            WHEN fee_month < month THEN 'fee of earlier months'
            WHEN fee_month = month THEN 'fee of this month'
            ELSE 'fee paid ahead' END AS part,
       sum(amount) AS amount
  FROM nlq.fee_receipt_heads
 WHERE month = date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)::date
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY amount DESC

examples.question: Late fee collected each month this financial year
examples.sql:
SELECT month, ledger, sum(amount) AS late_fee_collected
  FROM nlq.fee_receipt_heads
 WHERE line_kind = 'late_fee'
   AND received_on BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2027-03-31'
 GROUP BY month, ledger
 ORDER BY month, ledger

views.oneRowIs: one fee receipt (school or hostel ledger) that counts as money received

examples.question: Fee collected this month by payment mode
examples.sql:
SELECT mode_name, count(*) AS receipts, sum(amount) AS collected
  FROM nlq.fee_receipts
 WHERE month = date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)::date
 GROUP BY mode_name
 ORDER BY collected DESC

examples.question: Fee collection by class: this month against last month
examples.sql:
SELECT class,
       COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE month = date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)::date), 0) AS this_month,
       COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE month = (date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date) - interval '1 month')::date), 0) AS last_month
  FROM nlq.fee_receipts
 WHERE received_on >= (date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date) - interval '1 month')::date
 GROUP BY class, class_order
 ORDER BY class_order

examples.question: Fee received, refunded and net, month by month this financial year
examples.sql:
WITH rec AS (
  SELECT month, sum(amount) AS received
    FROM nlq.fee_receipts
   WHERE received_on BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2027-03-31'
   GROUP BY month),
ref AS (
  SELECT month, sum(amount) AS refunded
    FROM nlq.fee_refunds
   WHERE paid_on BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2027-03-31'
   GROUP BY month)
SELECT COALESCE(rec.month, ref.month) AS month,
       COALESCE(rec.received, 0) AS received,
       COALESCE(ref.refunded, 0) AS refunded,
       COALESCE(rec.received, 0) - COALESCE(ref.refunded, 0) AS net_received
  FROM rec FULL JOIN ref ON ref.month = rec.month
 ORDER BY 1

examples.question: Which pupils of VI-A have no fee receipt this year?

examples.question: Refunds paid on withdrawals this year, by class

examples.question: Largest refunds paid this month

views.oneRowIs: one gate pass (pupil early leave or late arrival, boarder's hostel leave, staff RGP / NRGP)

examples.question: Early leaves by class this month: asked, approved and rejected

examples.question: Which pupils left early most often since October?
examples.sql: SELECT admission_no, student_name, class_section, count(*) AS early_leaves FROM nlq.gate_passes WHERE kind = 'early_leave' AND through_the_gate AND pass_on >= DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY admission_no, student_name, class_section ORDER BY early_leaves DESC LIMIT 10

examples.question: Which staff are out on a returnable gate pass now, and are they overdue?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_code, employee_name, department, pass_no, pass_on, due_back_on, overdue_now, items_not_back FROM nlq.gate_passes WHERE kind = 'rgp' AND state = 'out' ORDER BY due_back_on NULLS LAST

examples.question: How long do gate pass approvals take, kind by kind, this month?

examples.question: Which boarders came back late from home leave this month?

views.oneRowIs: one helpdesk ticket (parent, staff, provider, hostel or admission desk)

examples.question: How many parent queries are open and overdue under each head?
examples.sql: SELECT head, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_open) AS open, count(*) FILTER (WHERE overdue) AS overdue FROM nlq.helpdesk_queries WHERE desk = 'parent' GROUP BY head ORDER BY open DESC

examples.question: How fast does each desk answer and close tickets, month by month?
examples.sql: SELECT month, desk, count(*) AS raised, round(avg(hours_to_first_response), 1) AS avg_hours_to_first_answer, round(avg(hours_to_close), 1) AS avg_hours_to_close, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_within_sla) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'closed'), 0), 0) AS within_sla_pct FROM nlq.helpdesk_queries WHERE opened_on >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - interval '5 months' GROUP BY month, desk ORDER BY month, desk

examples.question: Which classes have raised the most complaints this year?
examples.sql: SELECT h.class, h.class_order, count(*) AS complaints, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.is_open) AS still_open FROM nlq.helpdesk_queries h JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = h.academic_year_id WHERE y.is_current AND h.desk = 'parent' AND h.kind = 'complaint' GROUP BY h.class, h.class_order ORDER BY complaints DESC

examples.question: Which tickets are overdue now, and whom are they waiting on?
examples.sql: SELECT number, desk, head, opened_on, due_on, level, COALESCE(assigned_to, assigned_role) AS waiting_on FROM nlq.helpdesk_queries WHERE overdue ORDER BY due_on, number

examples.question: Parent queries by house this session, with their average rating
examples.sql: SELECT st.house, count(*) AS queries, round(avg(q.rating), 1) AS avg_rating FROM nlq.helpdesk_queries q JOIN nlq.students st ON st.student_id = q.student_id AND st.academic_year_id = q.academic_year_id WHERE q.desk = 'parent' AND q.opened_on >= DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY st.house ORDER BY queries DESC

views.oneRowIs: one daily-work post (homework, classwork or assignment) to one section

examples.question: How much homework has each section got this week?

examples.question: Which teachers posted the most homework this month?

examples.question: Which sections got no homework in the last 7 days?

examples.question: How many families acknowledged the homework that asked for it in the last two weeks?

examples.question: Subject-wise homework, classwork and assignments for Class VIII this month
examples.sql: SELECT h.subject_name, h.kind, count(*) AS posts FROM nlq.homework h JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = h.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE h.class = 'Class VIII' AND h.month = date_trunc('month', current_date)::date GROUP BY h.subject_name, h.kind ORDER BY posts DESC

views.oneRowIs: one bed of a hostel room with today’s occupancy

examples.question: Which room types have free beds?

examples.question: Which sections have the most overdue books?

views.oneRowIs: one outgoing message (one address on one channel; one push per device)

examples.question: How did our messages do this month, channel by channel?

examples.question: How many SMS units did we use each month this year, and what did they cost?

examples.question: Which circulars went out in the last week, and how many failed?

examples.question: Which automatic alerts went out most in the last 30 days?
examples.sql: SELECT template_name, channel, count(*) AS messages FROM nlq.messages WHERE kind = 'alert' AND created_on >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 30 GROUP BY template_name, channel ORDER BY messages DESC LIMIT 10

examples.question: What share of WhatsApp messages were delivered each day in the last two weeks?
examples.sql: SELECT created_on, count(*) FILTER (WHERE went_out) AS went_out, count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered) AS delivered, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE went_out), 0), 1) AS delivered_pct FROM nlq.messages WHERE channel = 'whatsapp' AND created_on >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 13 GROUP BY created_on ORDER BY created_on

examples.question: Who has not yet paid for the trip?

examples.question: Overdue misc fees by class

examples.question: Registration and admission fees collected each month this financial year

examples.question: Misc collection by mode for 1 to 23 November 2026, leaving out transfers

views.oneRowIs: one pay head of one employee x one pay month (all runs of the month summed)

examples.question: How much did we pay under each pay head (basic, DA, HRA, PF, TDS ...) in October 2026?

examples.question: How much PF and voluntary PF was deducted from staff each month this year?

examples.question: Arrears paid this financial year, by pay head
examples.sql: SELECT pay_head, count(DISTINCT employee_id) AS staff, sum(arrear_amount) AS arrears_paid FROM nlq.payslip_lines WHERE financial_year = '2026-27' AND arrear_amount <> 0 AND is_final GROUP BY pay_head ORDER BY arrears_paid DESC

examples.question: Basic pay as a share of gross salary by department for October 2026
examples.sql: SELECT p.department, sum(p.gross_pay) AS gross, COALESCE(sum(l.amount), 0) AS basic, round(100 * COALESCE(sum(l.amount), 0) / NULLIF(sum(p.gross_pay), 0), 1) AS basic_percent_of_gross FROM nlq.payslips p LEFT JOIN nlq.payslip_lines l ON l.employee_id = p.employee_id AND l.month = p.month AND l.pay_head_code = 'BASIC' WHERE p.month = DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.department ORDER BY gross DESC

examples.question: Who had a loan or advance instalment recovered from their October 2026 salary?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_code, employee_name, department, pay_head, amount FROM nlq.payslip_lines WHERE month = DATE '2026-10-01' AND category = 'LOAN' ORDER BY amount DESC

views.oneRowIs: one employee x one pay month (all runs of the month summed)

examples.question: What was the salary bill (gross, deductions, net, cost to school) each month this financial year?
examples.sql: SELECT month, count(*) AS staff_paid, sum(gross_pay) AS gross, sum(total_deductions) AS deductions, sum(net_pay) AS net, sum(cost_to_school) AS cost_to_school, bool_and(is_final) AS all_final FROM nlq.payslips WHERE financial_year = '2026-27' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

examples.question: Salary cost by department for October 2026, with the school's PF and ESI share
examples.sql: SELECT department, count(*) AS staff, sum(gross_pay) AS gross, sum(employer_pf + employer_esi + employer_other) AS employer_share, sum(cost_to_school) AS cost_to_school FROM nlq.payslips WHERE month = DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY department ORDER BY cost_to_school DESC

examples.question: Whose October 2026 salary is held or not yet paid?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_code, employee_name, department, pay_mode, pay_status, net_pay FROM nlq.payslips WHERE month = DATE '2026-10-01' AND pay_status IN ('held', 'to_pay') ORDER BY net_pay DESC

examples.question: How much income tax (TDS) has been deducted from each employee this financial year?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_id, max(employee_code) AS employee_code, max(employee_name) AS employee_name, sum(gross_pay) AS gross, sum(tds) AS tds_deducted FROM nlq.payslips WHERE financial_year = '2026-27' AND is_final GROUP BY employee_id ORDER BY tds_deducted DESC

examples.question: Average take-home pay of current teaching staff in October 2026, by gender
examples.sql: SELECT s.gender, count(*) AS staff, round(avg(p.net_pay), 2) AS average_net_pay FROM nlq.payslips p JOIN nlq.staff s ON s.employee_id = p.employee_id WHERE p.month = DATE '2026-10-01' AND p.staff_group = 'teaching' AND s.is_current GROUP BY s.gender ORDER BY s.gender

views.oneRowIs: one item line of a placed purchase order

examples.question: What did we spend on each item category this financial year?

examples.question: At what rates have we bought paper, and from whom?

examples.question: Which 10 items did we spend most on this year?

views.oneRowIs: a placed purchase order (approved, sent or closed; the revision in force)

examples.question: How much has each department spent on purchases this financial year?

examples.question: Show purchase spend month by month this financial year.

examples.question: Who are our top 10 vendors by purchases this year, and which are MSMEs?

examples.question: Which purchase orders are late for delivery?

views.oneRowIs: one class-section's day register on one school day

examples.question: Attendance by section today
examples.sql: SELECT class_section, marked, present, absent, on_leave, present_pct FROM nlq.section_attendance WHERE on_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date ORDER BY class_order, section

examples.sql: SELECT cs.class_section, cs.class_teacher FROM nlq.class_sections cs WHERE cs.is_current_year AND cs.strength > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nlq.section_attendance sa WHERE sa.class_section_id = cs.class_section_id AND sa.on_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date) ORDER BY cs.class_order, cs.section

examples.question: School attendance % day by day for the last 30 days
examples.sql: SELECT on_date, sum(present) AS present, sum(marked) AS marked, round(100.0 * sum(present) / NULLIF(sum(marked), 0), 1) AS present_pct FROM nlq.section_attendance WHERE on_date > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 30 GROUP BY on_date ORDER BY on_date

examples.question: Month-wise attendance % of each class this year
examples.sql: SELECT sa.class, sa.month, round(100.0 * sum(sa.present) / NULLIF(sum(sa.marked), 0), 1) AS present_pct FROM nlq.section_attendance sa JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = sa.academic_year_id WHERE y.is_current GROUP BY sa.class, sa.class_order, sa.month ORDER BY sa.class_order, sa.month

examples.question: Registers saved after the marking time this month, by who marked them
examples.sql: SELECT marked_by, count(*) AS registers FROM nlq.section_attendance WHERE marked_late AND on_date >= date_trunc('month', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)::date GROUP BY marked_by ORDER BY registers DESC

views.oneRowIs: one employee's worked-out attendance day (a day with no row is not marked)

examples.question: October attendance summary for every employee
examples.sql: SELECT employee_code, employee_name, sum(present_days) AS present, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_absent) AS absent, sum(paid_leave_days) AS paid_leave, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_late) AS late_days FROM nlq.staff_attendance_days WHERE month = DATE '2026-10-01' AND counted_in_reports GROUP BY employee_code, employee_name ORDER BY employee_name

examples.question: How many staff were present, absent and on leave on 20 November, by department?
examples.sql: SELECT department, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_present) AS present, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_absent) AS absent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE on_leave) AS on_leave FROM nlq.staff_attendance_days WHERE attendance_date = DATE '2026-11-20' AND counted_in_reports GROUP BY department ORDER BY department

examples.question: Who came late most often this month?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_code, employee_name, count(*) AS late_days, round(avg(late_minutes)) AS avg_minutes_late FROM nlq.staff_attendance_days WHERE is_late AND attendance_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-01' AND DATE '2026-11-30' GROUP BY employee_code, employee_name ORDER BY late_days DESC LIMIT 10

examples.question: Staff attendance % month by month this year
examples.sql: SELECT month, round(100 * (sum(present_days) + sum(paid_leave_days)) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_off_day), 0), 1) AS attendance_pct FROM nlq.staff_attendance_days WHERE financial_year = '2026-27' AND counted_in_reports GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

examples.question: Absent days in October, teaching vs non-teaching
examples.sql: SELECT s.staff_group, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.is_absent) AS absent_days FROM nlq.staff_attendance_days a JOIN nlq.staff s ON s.employee_id = a.employee_id WHERE a.month = DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY s.staff_group ORDER BY absent_days DESC

views.oneRowIs: the leave ledger of one employee × leave type × month (balance-keeping types only)

examples.question: What CL and EL balance does each employee have now?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_code, employee_name, leave_type, balance, used_pending FROM nlq.staff_leave_balances WHERE is_latest AND employee_is_current AND leave_type IN ('CL', 'EL') ORDER BY employee_name, leave_type

examples.question: Who has less than 2 days of casual leave left?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_code, employee_name, department, balance FROM nlq.staff_leave_balances WHERE is_latest AND employee_is_current AND leave_type = 'CL' AND balance < 2 ORDER BY balance, employee_name

examples.question: Total leave days left by department and leave type
examples.sql: SELECT department, leave_type, sum(balance) AS days_left, count(*) AS staff FROM nlq.staff_leave_balances WHERE is_latest AND employee_is_current GROUP BY department, leave_type ORDER BY department, leave_type

examples.question: How many leave days lapsed at the end of last leave year?
examples.sql: SELECT leave_type, sum(lapsed) AS days_lapsed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE lapsed > 0) AS staff_who_lost_days FROM nlq.staff_leave_balances WHERE month = DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY leave_type ORDER BY days_lapsed DESC

examples.question: Show employee E0123's leave ledger month by month this year
examples.sql: SELECT month, leave_type, opening, credited, used, correction, lapsed, balance FROM nlq.staff_leave_balances WHERE employee_code = 'E0123' AND financial_year = '2026-27' ORDER BY leave_type, month

views.oneRowIs: one approved day (or half day) of staff leave: employee × day × leave application

examples.question: How many days of each leave type were taken this year?
examples.sql: SELECT leave_type, leave_type_name, sum(days) AS days_taken, count(DISTINCT employee_id) AS staff FROM nlq.staff_leave_days WHERE financial_year = '2026-27' AND counted_in_reports GROUP BY leave_type, leave_type_name ORDER BY days_taken DESC

examples.question: Who is on leave today?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_name, department, leave_type, half FROM nlq.staff_leave_days WHERE leave_date = DATE '2026-11-23' AND is_working_day AND NOT counts_as_present ORDER BY department, employee_name

examples.question: Leave days by department, month by month this year
examples.sql: SELECT department, month, sum(days) AS leave_days FROM nlq.staff_leave_days WHERE financial_year = '2026-27' AND NOT counts_as_present GROUP BY department, month ORDER BY department, month

examples.question: Which 10 staff took the most leave this year?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_code, employee_name, sum(days) AS leave_days FROM nlq.staff_leave_days WHERE financial_year = '2026-27' AND NOT counts_as_present GROUP BY employee_code, employee_name ORDER BY leave_days DESC LIMIT 10

examples.question: Loss-of-pay days per employee in October, and how many the system charged
examples.sql: SELECT employee_code, employee_name, sum(days) AS lop_days, sum(days) FILTER (WHERE is_system_deduction) AS charged_by_system FROM nlq.staff_leave_days WHERE is_loss_of_pay AND month = DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY employee_code, employee_name ORDER BY lop_days DESC

views.oneRowIs: an item in a store now (in hand, reserved, free, value, reorder level)

examples.question: What is our stock worth in each store?
examples.sql: SELECT store, sum(value) AS stock_value, count(*) FILTER (WHERE qty > 0) AS items_in_stock FROM nlq.stock_balances GROUP BY store ORDER BY stock_value DESC

examples.question: Which items are at or below their reorder level?
examples.sql: SELECT store, item, free_qty, reorder_level, reorder_qty, unit FROM nlq.stock_balances WHERE below_reorder ORDER BY store, item

examples.question: What is the stock value by item category?
examples.sql: SELECT category, sum(value) AS stock_value FROM nlq.stock_balances GROUP BY category ORDER BY stock_value DESC

examples.question: Which items in stock have not moved for 90 days?
examples.sql: SELECT store, item, qty, unit, value, last_move_on FROM nlq.stock_balances WHERE qty > 0 AND last_move_on < current_date - 90 ORDER BY value DESC

views.oneRowIs: one move of an item into or out of a store (signed, store units)

examples.question: How much stock did each department consume this month?
examples.sql: SELECT department, -sum(value) AS consumed_value FROM nlq.stock_ledger WHERE is_consumption AND moved_on >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date GROUP BY department ORDER BY consumed_value DESC

examples.question: What value of goods came into the stores each month this financial year?
examples.sql: SELECT month, sum(value) AS received_value FROM nlq.stock_ledger WHERE kind = 'receipt' AND financial_year = '2026-27' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

examples.question: What was the stock worth in each store on 31 March 2026?
examples.sql: SELECT store, sum(value) AS stock_value FROM nlq.stock_ledger WHERE moved_on <= DATE '2026-03-31' GROUP BY store ORDER BY store

examples.question: What was written off or lost in physical counts this year?
examples.sql: SELECT kind_words, item, sum(qty) AS qty, min(unit) AS unit, sum(value) AS value FROM nlq.stock_ledger WHERE kind IN ('write_off', 'adjustment') AND financial_year = '2026-27' GROUP BY kind_words, item ORDER BY value

views.oneRowIs: one leave application for a pupil

examples.question: Which pupils are on leave today?
examples.sql: SELECT class_section, admission_no, student_name, leave_type_name, from_date, last_date FROM nlq.student_leaves WHERE status = 'approved' AND from_date <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AND last_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date ORDER BY class_order, section, student_name

examples.question: Pending leave applications and where they wait
examples.sql: SELECT waiting_at, count(*) AS leaves, min(applied_on) AS oldest_applied FROM nlq.student_leaves WHERE status = 'pending' GROUP BY waiting_at ORDER BY leaves DESC

examples.question: Leave applications by type this year with how many were approved
examples.sql: SELECT l.leave_type_name, count(*) AS applications, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'approved') AS approved, sum(l.days_taken) AS days_taken FROM nlq.student_leaves l JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = l.academic_year_id WHERE y.is_current GROUP BY l.leave_type_name ORDER BY applications DESC

examples.question: Approved leave days by class, month by month
examples.sql: SELECT l.class, l.month, count(*) AS leaves, sum(l.days_taken) AS days_taken FROM nlq.student_leaves l JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = l.academic_year_id WHERE y.is_current AND l.status = 'approved' GROUP BY l.class, l.class_order, l.month ORDER BY l.class_order, l.month

views.oneRowIs: one live teacher assignment: teacher × class section × subject (or class teacher / coordinator role) in an academic year

examples.question: Who teaches Mathematics, and in which sections, this year?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_name, string_agg(class_section, ', ' ORDER BY class_order, section) AS sections FROM nlq.teacher_subjects WHERE academic_year = '2026-27' AND subject = 'Mathematics' AND kind = 'subject_teacher' GROUP BY employee_name ORDER BY employee_name

examples.question: List the class teacher of every section
examples.sql: SELECT class_section, employee_name AS class_teacher FROM nlq.teacher_subjects WHERE academic_year = '2026-27' AND is_class_teacher ORDER BY class_order, section

examples.question: How many sections and subjects does each teacher take?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_code, employee_name, count(DISTINCT class_section_id) AS sections, count(DISTINCT subject_id) AS subjects FROM nlq.teacher_subjects WHERE academic_year = '2026-27' AND kind = 'subject_teacher' GROUP BY employee_code, employee_name ORDER BY sections DESC

examples.question: Which teachers who have left still hold classes?
examples.sql: SELECT employee_code, employee_name, role, class_section, subject FROM nlq.teacher_subjects WHERE academic_year = '2026-27' AND NOT employee_is_current ORDER BY employee_name, class_order

examples.question: Who teaches what in Class X, with their designation?
examples.sql: SELECT t.class_section, t.subject, t.employee_name, s.designation FROM nlq.teacher_subjects t JOIN nlq.staff s ON s.employee_id = t.employee_id WHERE t.academic_year = '2026-27' AND t.class = 'Class X' AND t.kind = 'subject_teacher' ORDER BY t.section, t.subject

views.oneRowIs: one pupil's term or annual result from the class's locked result register

examples.question: List of pupils with compartment or fail in the final result
examples.sql: SELECT t.class_section, t.admission_no, t.student_name, t.result, t.failed_count, t.failed_subjects, t.percent FROM nlq.term_results t JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = t.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE t.term_code = 'FINAL' AND t.result IN ('compartment', 'fail') ORDER BY t.class_order, t.class_section, t.result, t.student_name

examples.question: Pass, compartment and fail count by class for Term 1
examples.sql: SELECT t.class, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.result = 'pass') AS passed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.result = 'compartment') AS compartment, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.result = 'fail') AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.result IN ('absent', 'incomplete')) AS no_result_yet FROM nlq.term_results t JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = t.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE t.term_code = 'T1' GROUP BY t.class_order, t.class ORDER BY t.class_order

examples.question: Division-wise number of pupils who passed the final result, by class
examples.sql: SELECT t.class, COALESCE(t.division, 'No division') AS division, count(*) AS pupils FROM nlq.term_results t JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = t.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE t.term_code = 'FINAL' AND t.result = 'pass' GROUP BY t.class_order, t.class, t.division ORDER BY t.class_order, t.division

examples.question: Who topped each class in the final result?
examples.sql: SELECT t.class, t.admission_no, t.student_name, t.class_section, t.total, t.max_total, t.percent FROM nlq.term_results t JOIN nlq.academic_years y ON y.academic_year_id = t.academic_year_id AND y.is_current WHERE t.term_code = 'FINAL' AND t.rank_in_class = 1 ORDER BY t.class_order, t.student_name

views.oneRowIs: one pupil in one month they ride the school bus

examples.question: How many pupils use the school bus this month?
examples.sql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT student_id) AS pupils_on_bus
  FROM nlq.transport_riders
 WHERE is_current_month

examples.question: How many bus pupils are there in each class this month?
examples.sql:
SELECT class, count(DISTINCT student_id) AS pupils_on_bus
  FROM nlq.transport_riders
 WHERE is_current_month
 GROUP BY class, class_order
 ORDER BY class_order

examples.question: How has the number of bus pupils changed month by month?
examples.sql:
SELECT academic_year, month, count(DISTINCT student_id) AS pupils_on_bus
  FROM nlq.transport_riders
 GROUP BY academic_year, month
 ORDER BY month

examples.question: Which pupils board route R01 in the morning, and at which stop?
examples.sql:
SELECT student_name, admission_no, class_section, pick_stop_name, pickup_time
  FROM nlq.transport_riders
 WHERE is_current_month AND rides_morning AND pick_route_code = 'R01'
 ORDER BY pickup_time, student_name

examples.question: What is the expected transport amount per route this month?
examples.sql:
SELECT route_code, route_name, count(DISTINCT student_id) AS pupils, sum(monthly_amount) AS expected_monthly_rupees
  FROM nlq.transport_riders
 WHERE is_current_month
 GROUP BY route_code, route_name
 ORDER BY route_code

views.oneRowIs: one bus route with its vehicle, crew and riders this month

examples.question: Which buses are more than 90% full in the morning?
examples.sql:
SELECT route_code, route_name, vehicle_reg_no, capacity, morning_riders, morning_fill_percent
  FROM nlq.transport_routes
 WHERE status = 'active' AND morning_fill_percent >= 90
 ORDER BY morning_fill_percent DESC

examples.question: List the routes with their bus, driver and conductor.
examples.sql:
SELECT route_code, route_name, vehicle_reg_no, driver_name, conductor_name, stops, riders
  FROM nlq.transport_routes
 WHERE status = 'active'
 ORDER BY route_code

examples.question: Which routes are running a stand-in bus today?
examples.sql:
SELECT route_code, vehicle_reg_no, stand_in_reg_no
  FROM nlq.transport_routes
 WHERE has_stand_in_today
 ORDER BY route_code

examples.question: How many seats are free on each route in the morning?
examples.sql:
SELECT route_code, capacity, morning_riders, capacity - morning_riders AS seats_free_morning
  FROM nlq.transport_routes
 WHERE status = 'active' AND capacity IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY seats_free_morning DESC

views.oneRowIs: one visit through the school gate (walk-in, self-registered or appointment)

examples.question: How many visitors came each day this week?
examples.sql: SELECT visit_on, count(*) AS visits, sum(people) AS people, count(*) FILTER (WHERE by_appointment) AS by_appointment FROM nlq.visitors WHERE visit_on >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 6 GROUP BY visit_on ORDER BY visit_on

examples.question: How many visitors are inside now, and whom are they meeting?
examples.sql: SELECT host, count(*) AS visits, sum(people) AS people FROM nlq.visitors WHERE inside_now GROUP BY host ORDER BY people DESC

examples.question: What did visitors come for this month, and how long did they stay?
examples.sql: SELECT purpose, count(*) AS visits, round(avg(minutes_inside)) AS avg_minutes_inside FROM nlq.visitors WHERE month = date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date GROUP BY purpose ORDER BY visits DESC

examples.question: What are the busiest hours at the gate?
examples.sql: SELECT in_hour, count(*) AS visits FROM nlq.visitors WHERE visit_on >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 29 GROUP BY in_hour ORDER BY in_hour

examples.question: Which staff members had the most visitors this month?
examples.sql: SELECT s.employee_name, s.department, count(*) AS visits FROM nlq.visitors v JOIN nlq.staff s ON s.employee_id = v.host_employee_id WHERE v.month = date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date GROUP BY s.employee_name, s.department ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 10
